logp.method_description: The log P values for 4a–e were obtained by using the shake-flask method and GFAAS. Octanol used in this experiment was pre-saturated with PBS by overnight incubation with shaking of a biphasic mixture of the two at R.T. A portion of 0.3 mL PBS containing 50 μM Pt(IV) compound (4a–e) was incubated with the pre-saturated octanol (0.3 mL) in a 1.5 mL tube. The tube was shaken at R.T. for 3 h. The two phases were separated by centrifugation and the platinum content in each phase was determined by GFAAS. Owing to the low solubility of 4e in PBS, a pre-saturated octanol solution containing 50 μM of the platinum compound was used instead. All the experiments were carried out in triplicate.
